QuestInfo.name: Joining the Fight
QuestInfo.0: Agent N wants to talk to you. He may have new intel for you.
QuestInfo.1: Agent N wants to talk to you. He may have new intel for you.
QuestInfo.2: You learned of an organization called the Silent Crusade that is dedicated to hunting down the Black Mage. You might consider joining forces with them.

0.0: Hey. I get that you're busy, but you're going to want to hear this.\r\n#L0##bWhat news do you bring?#l\n#k
0.1: Have you ever heard of the Silent Crusade?\r\n#L0##bA crusade that is silent? Explain.#l\n#k
0.2: It looks like they're a secret organization that hunts down monsters. We don't know the exact details, but it sounds like they only go after the Black Mage's personal pets.\r\n#L0##bThen they are friends as far as I am concerned.#l\n#k
0.3: I thought you'd say that. You should check them out. If they end up being good guys, you could help each other a lot.

no.0: Fair enough. I'm sure you've already got plenty on your plate.
